title: Beyond Vertex Profiles: Edge-Local Spectral Information and Size-Dependent Scaling in Nonuniform Hypergraph Tensors
summary: Vertex edge-size profiles determine every slice row sum in the support-exact edge-total-mass tensor, but they do not determine spectral radius even when the complete labelled 2-edge layer is fixed. The manuscript proves a five-vertex minimal separation valid for every positive choice of 2- and 3-edge masses, develops an explicit edge-local Collatz–Wielandt bound with equality and defect theory, and derives size-dependent loose-star growth laws.
techniques: Exact equality characterization and defect estimates
